name: Kashoku no Ten
source:
At the urging of his friend, the main character, Itsuki Kashima, is sent to clean up his friend's relative's house deep in the mountains. On the way, he gets lost and wanders into an old shrine, where he encounters something hideous inside the main shrine and is attacked.
Trapped by the tentacles, Itsuki gradually drowns in the pleasures of the tentacles.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343630/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在朋友的催促下，主人公鹿岛树被派去清理朋友亲戚深山里的房子。途中，他迷路了，走进了一座古老的神社，在那里他在主神社内遇到了可怕的东西并受到了攻击。
被触手困住的伊月渐渐淹没在触手的快乐之中。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343630/]Steam[/url]]
